ref_atoms.ref_content: Inter-signal next_dm_addr: 32bit word address of the next debug module. Set to 0x0 if this is the last debug module in the chain.

ref_atoms.ref_content: Inter-signal lc_hw_debug_en: Multibit life cycle hardware debug enable signal coming from life cycle controller, asserted when the hardware debug mechanisms are enabled in the system.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: 指向特定信号 lc_hw_debug_en，描述其在硬件调试使能时断言的行为。

ref_atoms.ref_content: Inter-signal pinmux_hw_debug_en: This is a latched version of the lc_hw_debug_en signal and is only used to gate the JTAG / TAP side of the RV_DM. It is used to keep a debug session live while the rest of the system undergoes an NDM reset.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: 指向特定信号 pinmux_hw_debug_en，描述其锁存行为和门控 JTAG 功能。

ref_atoms.ref_content: Inter-signal lc_check_byp_en: Check bypass enable signal coming from life cycle controller, used for invalidating the latched lc_hw_debug_en state inside the strap sampling logic. This signal is asserted whenever the life cycle controller performs a life cycle transition. Its main use is to skip any background checks inside the life cycle partition of the OTP controller while a life cycle transition is in progress.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: 指向特定信号 lc_check_byp_en，描述其在生命周期转换时跳过检查的详细行为。

ref_atoms.ref_content: Inter-signal strap_en: This signal is pulsed high by the power manager after reset in order to sample the HW straps.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: 指向特定信号 strap_en，描述其复位后脉冲采样 straps 的行为。

ref_atoms.ref_content: Inter-signal strap_en_override: This signal transitions from 0 -> 1 by the lc_ctrl manager after volatile RAW_UNLOCK in order to re-sample the HW straps. The signal must stay at 1 until reset. Note that this is only used in test chips when SecVolatileRawUnlockEn = 1. Otherwise this signal is unused.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: 指向特定信号 strap_en_override，描述其重新采样 straps 的转换和保持行为。

ref_atoms.ref_content: Feature RV_DM.DBG.GDB: The debug module will work with GDB connected via OpenOCD over JTAG. In particular the following features will be functional from GDB: - Halting execution and resetting - Setting, hitting and deleting breakpoints using all available hardware breakpoints - Single stepping - Reading and writing all registers - Reading and writing CSRs - Reading and writing memory - Setting the PC to jump to some location - Executing code from GDB (using the call command)

ref_atoms.ref_content: Countermeasure BUS.INTEGRITY: End-to-end bus integrity scheme.
Countermeasure LC_HW_DEBUG_EN.INTERSIG.MUBI: The life cycle hardware debug enable signal is multibit encoded.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: 指向信号 lc_hw_debug_en，描述其多比特编码的防护。

ref_atoms.ref_content: Countermeasure LC_DFT_EN.INTERSIG.MUBI: The life cycle hardware DFT enable signal is multibit encoded.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: 指向信号 lc_dft_en，描述其多比特编码的防护。

ref_atoms.ref_content: Countermeasure OTP_DIS_RV_DM_LATE_DEBUG.INTERSIG.MUBI: The OTP chicken switch to disable late debug enablement is multibit encoded.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: 指向信号 otp_dis_rv_dm_late_debug，描述其多比特编码。

ref_atoms.ref_content: Countermeasure DM_EN.CTRL.LC_GATED: The debug module is enabled via a combination of the multibit encoded LC_DFT_EN, LC_HW_DEBUG_EN and OTP_DIS_RV_DM_LATE_DEBUG signals, as well as the LATE_DEBUG_ENABLE CSR. This enablement is implemented by gating / enabling critical blocks with separately buffered copies of the life cycle signal. This comprises the debug module interface (DMI) attached to the TAP, the reset request line, the system bus access module (SBA), the debug request output, the TL-UL adapter for the debug ROM, and the ifetch indicator being fed into the TL-UL adapter for the debug ROM. In terms of gating conditions, the debug module implements a mechanism that allows for a 'late' debug enable in the DEV life cycle state: - Debug is always enabled unconditionally in DFT-enabled life cycle states (TEST_UNLOCKED* and RMA). - Debug is always enabled unconditionally in the DEV life cycle state iff OTP_DIS_RV_DM_LATE_DEBUG is set to kMuBi8True. - Debug is conditionally enabled based on the value of the LATE_DEBUG_ENABLE CSR in the DEV life cycle state iff OTP_DIS_RV_DM_LATE_DEBUG is set to kMuBi8False (or any invalid MuBi value). - Debug is always disabled in all other life cycle states.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: 详细描述 debug 模块的门控条件，涉及多个信号和寄存器。

ref_atoms.ref_content: Countermeasure SBA_TL_LC_GATE.FSM.SPARSE: The control FSM inside the TL-UL gating primitive is sparsely encoded.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: 描述 SBA TL-UL 门控原语中 FSM 的稀疏编码。

ref_atoms.ref_content: Countermeasure MEM_TL_LC_GATE.FSM.SPARSE: The control FSM inside the TL-UL gating primitive is sparsely encoded.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: 描述 MEM TL-UL 门控原语中 FSM 的稀疏编码。

ref_atoms.ref_content: Countermeasure EXEC.CTRL.MUBI: The instruction fetch enable signal that is modulated with LC_HW_DEBUG_EN and that feeds into the TL-UL adapter is multibit encoded.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: 描述指令获取使能信号的多比特编码，涉及 LC_HW_DEBUG_EN。

ref_atoms.ref_content: Register LATE_DEBUG_ENABLE_REGWEN: Lock bit for LATE_DEBUG_ENABLE register. If this bit is cleared to 0, the LATE_DEBUG_ENABLE register cannot be written anymore.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: 指向寄存器 LATE_DEBUG_ENABLE_REGWEN，描述其锁定 LATE_DEBUG_ENABLE 写权限的行为。

ref_atoms.ref_content: Register LATE_DEBUG_ENABLE: Debug enable register. If the device is in the DEV lifecycle state and the DIS_RV_DM_LATE_DEBUG_IN_DEV has been programmed to kMuBi8False (or an invalid value), the RV_DM gating mechanisms are by default not ungated until SW writes kMuBi32True to this register. This can be leveraged to implement a 'late debug enable in DEV' policy, whereby ROM_EXT first locks out any sensitive areas and functionalities of the device before enabling debug access via RV_DM. This register can be locked out via LATE_DEBUG_ENABLE_REGWEN. This register does not have any effect in the following cases: - If the device is in a DFT-enabled life cycle state (TEST_UNLOCKED*, RMA) - If the device is in the DEV life cycle state and DIS_RV_DM_LATE_DEBUG_IN_DEV has been programmed to kMuBi8True - If the device is in a life cycle state where hardware debugging is disabled (TEST_LOCKED*, PROD*, invalid states). A value of kMuBi32True enables the debug module, all other values disable it.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: 详细描述 LATE_DEBUG_ENABLE 寄存器控制 debug 使能的条件和行为。

ref_atoms.ref_content: Memory address HALTED: Written by a hart whenever it enters debug mode. A hart entering debug mode must write its ID to this address to indicate that it has halted. When the debug module triggers a debug mode (aka halt) request to the hart, the hart will jump to the debug ROM. In that debug ROM, the hart must write its ID here to acknowledge completion of the request. When the write is received, the debug module will record that the hart is halted in its status register. In addition, the debug module may begin to accept abstract commands that run on that hart. Note that this write upon entering debug mode is also important for indicating that a sequence of debug mode instructions completed. In that case, the hart would write to this address while it was already halted.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: 描述 HALTED 地址的硬件握手行为，涉及 hart 写入 ID、状态记录和命令接受。

ref_atoms.ref_content: Memory address GOING: Written by a hart to acknowledge a command. A hart that receives an abstract command (indicated by its corresponds FLAGS register) must write to this address to acknowledge it received the command. The value written is unused, but it is conventionally 0. Upon receiving the write, the debug module will reset the GO field in the selected hart's FLAGS register. The debug module will transition to a state where it awaits the write to HALTED to indicate the command has completed.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: 描述 GOING 地址的确认命令行为，涉及 FLAGS 寄存器的 GO 位复位和等待 HALTED 写入。

ref_atoms.ref_content: Memory address RESUMING: Written by a hart to acknowledge a resume request. A hart that receives the command to resume from debug mode (via the RESUME flag in its FLAGS register) must write its ID to this address. This write tells the debug module that the command has been acknowledged, and the hart is no longer halted.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: 描述 RESUMING 地址的恢复确认行为，涉及 FLAGS 寄存器的 RESUME 标志和 hart 状态。

ref_atoms.ref_content: Memory address EXCEPTION: An exception was triggered while the core was in debug mode.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: 描述 EXCEPTION 地址在调试模式下触发异常的行为。

ref_atoms.ref_content: Memory address WHERETO: A jump instruction the hart executes to begin a command. When a debugger sends an abstract command to the debug module, the debug module indicates the instruction to run here, which is invariably a jump. The hart receiving the command must execute the instruction at this address after acknowledging the command with the write to GOING. Similarly, when a debugger requests that a hart resume, the debug module supplies a jump instruction to execute here. In the resume request case, the hart must execute the indicated instruction after acknolwedging the request with the write to RESUMING.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: 描述 WHERETO 地址的跳转指令执行流程，与 GOING 和 RESUMING 写入关联。

ref_atoms.ref_content: Multiregister group ABSTRACTCMD: A ROM containing instructions for implementing abstract commands. The hart executes these instructions at the debug modules behest. The debug module's jump instruction at WHERETO will land here, except for the AccessRegister command with the 'postexec' bit set and the 'transfer' bit unset. See the RISC-V Debug Specification for more information on the encoding of abstract commands.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: 描述 ABSTRACTCMD ROM 存储抽象命令指令，与 WHERETO 跳转关联。

ref_atoms.ref_content: Multiregister group PROGRAM_BUFFER: A buffer for the debugger to write small debug mode programs. The hart may run these programs by command from the debugger. See the RISC-V Debug Specification for more information about the Program Buffer and how it is used with abstract commands and the 'postexec' bit.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: 描述程序缓冲区用于存放调试小程序，hart 可按命令执行。

ref_atoms.ref_content: Multiregister group DATAADDR: Message Registers for passing arguments and/or return values for abstract commands. See the RISC-V Debug Specification for more information about Message Registers and their relationship to abstract commands.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: 描述 DATAADDR 消息寄存器用于抽象命令的参数传递。

ref_atoms.ref_content: Multiregister group FLAGS: Flags indicating what a hart in debug mode should do. These flags are how a debug module signals whether a hart should execute an abstract command, resume from debug mode, or remain idle. Each hart has its own FLAGS register that is a single byte. Bit 0 is the GO flag, indicating a request for the selected hart to execute the command. Bit 1 is the RESUME flag, indication a request for the selected hart to resume from halt/ debug mode. The other bits are reserved. The hart finds its own FLAGS register by taking the base address of this group and adding the hart's ID to the byte address. These are written by the debug module. When a selected hart writes the GOING register, the corresponding GO flag is cleared. When a selected hart writes the RESUMING register, the corresponding RESUME flag is cleared.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: 详细描述 FLAGS 寄存器的位定义和清零行为，与 GOING、RESUMING 写入关联。

ref_atoms.ref_content: Window ROM: Access window into the debug ROM.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: 定义调试 ROM 的访问窗口。

ref_atoms.ref_content: Window dbg: Access window to DM CSRs.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: 定义 DM CSR 的访问窗口。

ref_atoms.ref_content: The lc_hw_debug_en_i signal is encoded as lc_tx_t and is used through the lc_hw_debug_en_gated signal when late debug enable is enabled (through the late_debug_enable register or the otp_dis_rv_dm_late_debug_i pin). Bad values of this signal should be interpreted as 'Off', disabling debug and also memory/sba TL access. When late debug is enabled, set this to a value other than On and check: No ndmreset is possible (true because the ndmreset_ack signal is gated); No debug request can be sent to the core through debug_req_o; Instruction fetch requests through the memory window are not successful; The 'mem' and 'sba' TL interfaces are both disabled. Tests implement this with either late debug enable active (using lc_hw_debug_en_i) or inactive (using otp_dis_rv_dm_late_debug_i), with a 50% chance of each.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Specifies lc_hw_debug_en_i signal and its gating effect on ndmreset_ack, debug_req_o, mem/sba interfaces, with clear expected behaviors.

ref_atoms.ref_content: Analogous to LC_HW_DEBUG_EN.INTERSIG.MUBI testpoint but for lc_dft_en_i when late debug enable is not active: corrupted signal is lc_dft_en_i; otherwise identical behavior (when late debug enable is off).
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Identifies lc_dft_en_i as the corrupted signal under specific condition (late debug off), inheriting the same MUBI checking behavior.

ref_atoms.ref_content: Control of whether to use late debug is governed by both the otp_dis_rv_dm_late_debug_i port and the late_debug_enable register. In both cases, bad values of the signal are interpreted as 'Off', causing debug enable to be controlled by the lc_dft_en_i port instead of the lc_hw_debug_en_i port. To test, set both the otp_dis_rv_dm_late_debug_i port and the late_debug_enable register to values that are not strict mubi true values, then check that debug enable is caused by lc_dft_en_i.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Explicitly names otp_dis_rv_dm_late_debug_i and late_debug_enable register, describes MUBI encoding interpretation and control switch to lc_dft_en_i.

ref_atoms.ref_content: There are five buffered copies of the lifecycle enable signal: LcEnFetch controls whether hart fetch requests to debug module's memory are relayed (implemented with en_ifetch_i in tlul_adapter_reg); LcEnRom controls hart access to debug module's memory, gating TL transactions; LcEnSba controls whether SBA transactions are relayed; LcEnDebugReq controls whether a debug request from the debug module is relayed to the hart; LcEnResetReq controls whether ndmreset request is relayed. These are buffered to prevent corruption of one from affecting others. Verify that when debug is disabled, forcing one copy does not activate any of the other features.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Describes five distinct enable copies (LcEnFetch, LcEnRom, LcEnSba, LcEnDebugReq, LcEnResetReq) with specific gating effects and buffering to avoid cross-corruption, with a verification condition.

ref_atoms.ref_content: The gate at u_tlul_lc_gate_sba has a sparse FSM; a fault injection of only a couple of bits cannot change between valid values. Inject a 1- or 2-bit error and check that the fatal_fault alert is triggered.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Points to u_tlul_lc_gate_sba gate instance, details sparse FSM behavior and the expected fatal_fault alert upon a 1-2 bit fault injection.

ref_atoms.ref_content: The gate at u_tlul_lc_gate_rom has a sparse FSM; a fault injection of only a couple of bits cannot change between valid values. Inject a 1- or 2-bit error and check that the fatal_fault alert is triggered.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Points to u_tlul_lc_gate_rom gate instance, details sparse FSM behavior and the expected fatal_fault alert upon a 1-2 bit fault injection.

ref_atoms.ref_content: The multi-bit nature of the signal is checked by all tests that disable debug (choosing an arbitrary value other than On). The rv_dm_buffered_enable test provides a tighter check that fetch requests are more tightly controlled than arbitrary TL requests.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Describes the multi-bit encoding check on the execution control signal and how fetch requests are more stringently controlled, verified by rv_dm_buffered_enable.

ref_atoms.ref_content:
A basic smoke test.

            . Read the DTM register `idcode` and verify that it reflects the correct value.
            - Enable debug by setting lc_hw_debug_en to true.
            - Write to the DMI register field dmcontrol[dmactive] via JTAG and verify that the
              `dmactive` output pin reflects the same value.
            - Write to the DMI register field dmcontrol[haltreq] via JTAG and verify that the
              `debug_req` output pin reflects the same value.
            - Write to the DMI register field dmcontrol[ndmreset] via JTAG and verify that the
              `ndmreset` output pin reflects the same value.
            - Wiggle the `unavailable` input and read the DTM register field dmstatus[allunavail]
              to verify that it reflects the same value as the input signal.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: 指名具体寄存器（idcode, dmcontrol）及输出信号（dmactive, debug_req, ndmreset, unavailable），详细验证步骤

ref_atoms.ref_content:
Verify that the JTAG IDCODE reads the correct value.

            - Set a different JTAG ID code an rv_dm design parameter.
            - Read the IDCODE register in JTAG DTM register space, via JTAG.
            - Verify it reads back what was set.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: 指名寄存器IDCODE及设计参数rv_dm，步骤明确

ref_atoms.ref_content:
Verify that the debugger can cancel an on-going DMI transaction with a hard reset.

            - Perform DMI register read and check the data value.
            - Write 1 to dtmcs[dmihardreset] bit.
            - Perform DMI register read and check the data value to make sure the reset doesn't
              create any harmful event.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: 指名寄存器dtmcs[dmihardreset]及DMI操作，验证硬复位取消行为

ref_atoms.ref_content:
Verify that the JTAG debugger does not need to stay any longer than the advertized idle time indicated in dtmcs register.

            - Read the dtmcs[idle] value and configure the JTAG DMI register adapter to insert that
              many delay between transactions.
            - Issue random legal DMI accesses back to back and ensure that all of them complete
              successfully, without dmistat reflecting an error.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: 指名寄存器dtmcs[idle]及dmistat，验证空闲时间提示机制

ref_atoms.ref_content:
Verify that a failed DMI op is reflected properly in dtmcs register.

            - Issue a random legal DMI write to a chosen DMI register.
            - Before that access completes, issue another random legal DMI access.
            - Read the dtmcs[dmistat] register to verify busy error.
            - Clear it by writing to dtmcs[dmireset] register.
            - Poll the DMI access for completion and verify that the first write completed
              successfully by doing a read-check.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: 指名寄存器dtmcs[dmistat]和dtmcs[dmireset]，验证失败DMI操作的错误反映与清除

ref_atoms.ref_content:
Verify that DMI writes to data other than dmcontrol.dmactive are ignored when dmactive is false. All of these registers should return their reset values on reads.

            - Write 0 to DMCONTROL.DMACTIVE to put the debug module into its reset state.
            - Perform random DMI writes, constrained only by requiring that they don't write 1 to
              DMCONTROL.DMACTIVE.
            - Write 1 to DMCONTROL.DMACTIVE to leave the reset state.
            - Read DMI registers back and check they have their POR values.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: 指名寄存器DMCONTROL.DMACTIVE及POR值行为，验证dmactive对DMI写入的保护

ref_atoms.ref_content:
Verify all types of accesses from JTAG to SBA.

            - Enable debug by setting lc_hw_debug_en to true and activate the dm
            - Write to SBA registers to inject randomized 8/16/32bit writes and reads.
            - Randomize readonaddr and readondata settings and ensure those have the intended
              effect.
            - Generate sbbusy = 1 scenario by picking a very large response delay, since JTAG
              accesses are much slower (SBA TL accesses tend to complete faster than JTAG can
              read the SBCS register).
ref_atoms.kind_reason: 指名SBA寄存器、readonaddr/readondata设置及sbbusy信号，验证多种SBA访问类型

ref_atoms.ref_content:
Verify attempts to make bad SBA accesses results in the error sticky bits getting set.

            - Enable debug by setting lc_hw_debug_en to true and activate the dm.
            - Build on the previous `sba` test and randomly inject errors in the following
              ways:
              - Inject a response error on the TL response channel (d_error = 1) and verify that
                the sberror bit is set to 2.
              - Inject a randomized SBA access that is not aligned to the size of the transfer and
                verify that the sberror bit is set to 3.
              - Inject a randomized SBA access that is greater that the supported transfer size and
                verify that the sberror bit is set to 4.
              - Inject an integrity error on the TL response channel and verify that the sberror
                bit is set to 7. Verify that an alert is seen. Reset the DUT.
              - Inject a new SBA traffic before the previous one completes - verify that the
                sbbusyerror asserts. This is achieved by setting a large TL response delay (TODO).
              - Have more than one of these types of errors trigger at the same time.

            Note: The following error scenarios are not supported by the design:
            - pulp-platform/riscv-dbg#128: response timeout (sberror = 1) is not implemented.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: 指名sberror错误位各种编码、sbbusyerror、alert及TL响应错误注入，验证SBA错误处理

ref_atoms.ref_content:
Verify the address autoincrement functionality of SBA.

            - Enable debug by setting lc_hw_debug_en to true and activate the dm.
            - Write to the SBCS register to inject randomized 8/16/32bit writes. Set the
              autoincrement bit.
            - Pick a random address and write to sbaddress0 register.
            - Write a random value to sbdata0, repeating a randomized number of times.
            - Each write should trigger a new SBA TL write access with the address incremented with
              the transfer size. Verify that the SBA TL access shows up.
            - Repeat the same procedure for reads. For reads, set the readondata register and read
              the sbdata0 a randomized number of times - each read should trigger a new SBA TL read
              access.
            - Intermittently also generate busy and error conditions.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: 指名SBCS、sbaddress0、sbdata0、autoincrement位及readondata，验证SBA地址自增功能

ref_atoms.ref_content:
Verify that the JTAG DMI register space cannot be accessed if pinmux_hw_debug_en is a non strict true value.

            - Set pinmux_hw_debug_en to true and activate the dm.
            - Write a known value to a randomly picked DMI CSR.
            - Set pinmux_hw_debug_en to non-true value.
            - Write a different value to the same DMI CSR.
            - Attempt to read that DMI CSR - it should read all 0s.
            - Note that the above steps are rendered moot because the JTAG DTM itself will not
              receive any incoming JTAG transactions.
            - Set pinmux_hw_debug_en to true and again read the DMI CSR - it should reflect the
              originally written value.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: 指名信号pinmux_hw_debug_en控制DMI CSR访问，读取全0行为

ref_atoms.ref_content:
Verify that access to SBA interface is disabled if lc_hw_debug_en is set to a value other than lc_ctrl_pkg::On.

            - Set lc_hw_debug_en to non-true value and activate the dm.
            - Attempt to send some legal randomized SBA accesses. Checks in the scoreboard will
              assert that no SBA TL accesses appear on the TL interface.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: 指名信号lc_hw_debug_en控制SBA接口访问，验证无TL访问出现

ref_atoms.ref_content:
Verify that the debugger can issue a non-debug reset to the rest of the system.

            - Set lc_hw_debug_en / pinmux_hw_debug_en to true value and activate the dm.
            - Pick a random set of write/readable CSRs in the debug RALs (JTAG DMI and debug
              memory). Write known values to them.
            - Write the dmcontrol register to assert ndmreset - verify that the ndmreset output
              is asserted.
            - Mimic the CPU going into reset by asserting the unavailable input.
            - Set lc_hw_debug_en to something other than On (since it should no longer be needed).
              At this point the ndmreset output signal will drop. Keep pinmux_hw_debug_en set to On
              to keep the JTAG side open while the ndmreset is in progress.
            - Read the dmstatus register to verify allunavail is asserted.
            - De-assert the ndmreset by writing 0 to the dmcontrol register field, verify the
              ndmreset output deasserted as well.
            - Mimic the CPU going out of reset by de-asserting unavailable input
              after some delay. Set lc_hw_debug_en to true again as well.
            - Read the previously written registers back and verify that they reflect the previously
              written value, proving that ndmreset assertion had no effect on them.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: 指名ndmreset输出、unavailable输入、dmcontrol、dmstatus allunavail，验证非调试复位行为

ref_atoms.ref_content:
Verify that the debugger can read the status of unavailable hart

            - Set lc_hw_debug_en to true value and activate the dm.
            - Randomly assert and de-assert the `unavailable` input (indicates the CPU is under
              reset). This ideally happens when ndmreset is issued by the debugger.
            - Periodically issue reads to dmstatus register to verify allunavail matches the
              `unavailable` input value
ref_atoms.kind_reason: 指名unavailable输入与dmstatus allunavail位的对应关系

ref_atoms.ref_content:
Generate the "busy" command error in abstractcs.

            - Start an abstract command executing (but don't allow it to stop)

            - Write to one of command, abstractcs, abstractauto or access (read or write) the data
              or progbuf register.

            - Read the abstractcs register and check that cmderr is now set to 1 (the encoding of
              "busy")
ref_atoms.kind_reason: 指名abstractcs.cmderr为1（busy）的触发条件及寄存器操作

ref_atoms.ref_content:
Generate the "not supported" command error in abstractcs

            This command error is generated when trying to run an abstract command that is not
            supported.

            - Write a command to the command register where cmdtype is definitely not supported.
            - Check that the cmderr field of abstractcs register is set to 2.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: 指名abstractcs.cmderr为2（not supported）的条件及命令寄存器操作

ref_atoms.ref_content:
Verify that if an exception occurs when executing a command then cmderr is set to 3.

             - Start an abstract command.
             - While it's running, write to the exception register over TL.
             - Check that the cmderr field of abstractcs register is now 3.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: 指名exception寄存器写入导致cmderr为3的机制

ref_atoms.ref_content:
Verify whether the selected hart has been resumed or not.

            -Write into memory mapped register called RESUMING(0x110) through tl-device interface.
            -Verify that the anyresumeack and allresumeack bits of the dmstatus register are set.
            -After that, set the resumereq bit of dmcontrol register.
            -Verify that the anyresumeack and allresumeack bits of the dmstatus register are cleared.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: 指名RESUMING寄存器、anyresumeack/allresumeack及dmcontrol.resumereq，验证恢复状态

ref_atoms.ref_content:
Verify whether the selected hart has been halted or not.

            - Set the haltreq bit of dmcontrol register.
            - Write into memory mapped register called HALTED(0x100) through tl-device(mem_tl_if) interface.
            - Verify that the anyhalted and allhalted bits of the dmstatus register are set.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: 指名HALTED寄存器、haltreq及anyhalted/allhalted，验证halt状态

ref_atoms.ref_content:
Verify that attempt to generate command error result in cmderr field of abstractcs register are set.

            - Try to execute abstract command when hart is not in halt/resume state.
            - Assert unavailable signal through core interface.
            - The abstract command could not be execute.
            - Verify that the cmderr field of abstractcs register is set to 4.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: 指名unavailable信号与abstractcs.cmderr=4的关联

ref_atoms.ref_content:
Verify the read write access of the data registers through the memory mapped DataAddr register.

            - Write random data to the shadowed data registers via the corresponding DataAddr registers.
            - Read back the written data and verify that it matches the expected values.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: 指名DataAddr寄存器访问shadowed data registers的行为

ref_atoms.ref_content:
Verify debug module halt/going/resume behavior.

            - Request a halt over DMI, then send an abstract command.
            - Check that the debug module reports itself to be busy.
            - Check that the debug module's internal state machine is in the Go state.
            - As the hart, respond to the message from the debug module to say that it has started handling it.
            - Check the debug module still reports itself to be busy.
            - Check that WHERETO points at the expected address (which contains the start of the abstract command)
            - As the hart, tell the debug module that we have halted.
            - Check the debug module no longer reports itself to be busy.
            - Tell the debug module to resume again, by clearing the halt request and sending a resume request.
            - Check the debug module now reports itself busy again (since it should be asking the hart to resume)
            - Check flags to make sure the debug module is in the Resume state.
            - As the hart, acknowledge the resume request.
            - Check the debug module no longer reports itself to be busy.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: 指名halt、abstract command、busy、Go/Resume状态、WHERETO地址等具体状态机行为

ref_atoms.ref_content:
Verify that writing on DM progbuf registers while abstract command is executing causes jtag_dmi_ral.abstractcs.busy to be set to 1.

            This is implemented by rv_dm_cmderr_busy, which chooses a random operation to generate the busy command error. One possible operation is writing to progbuf[0].
ref_atoms.kind_reason: 指名progbuf寄存器写入与abstractcs.busy置位的关系

ref_atoms.ref_content:
Verify the functionality of abstract command by reading tl_mem_ral.abstractcmd0-9 registers.

            - Program jtag_dmi_ral.dmcontrol.haltreq to 1'b1.
            - Verify that the 'debug_req_o' is set to 1.
            - Acknowledge haltreq by setting tl_mem_ral.halted to 0.
            - Send a valid abstract command (command type AccessRegister).
            - Verify that the jtag_dmi_ral.abstractcs.busy is set to 1.
            - Read tl_mem_ral.abstractcmd0-9 registers to verify that due to executing specific abstract command we can read instructions stored in these registers.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: 指名abstractcmd0-9、haltreq、debug_req_o、abstractcs.busy，验证抽象命令执行

ref_atoms.ref_content:
Verify the functionality of program buffer by writing random data on program buffer.

            - Program jtag_dmi_ral.dmcontrol.haltreq to 1'b1.
            - Verify that 'debug_req_o' is set to 1.
            - Acknowledge haltreq by setting tl_mem_ral.halted to 0.
            - Fill the program buffer by writing random data to jtag_dmi_ral.progbuf0-7
              registers.
            - Read tl_mem_ral.program_buffer0-7 registers to verify that the data we wrote is what we read back.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: 指名progbuf0-7和program_buffer0-7寄存器，验证程序缓冲读取一致性

ref_atoms.ref_content:
Verify that writing on tl_mem_ral.exception register while an abstract command is executing causes jtag_dmi_ral.abstractcs.cmderr to be set to 3.

            - Program jtag_dmi_ral.dmcontrol.haltreq to 1'b1.
            - Verify that 'debug_req_o' is set to 1.
            - Acknowledge haltreq by setting tl_mem_ral.halted to 0.
            - Send access register abstract command with postexec bit set.
            - Write on tl_mem_ral.exception register.
            - Verify that jtag_dmi_ral.abstractcs.cmderr is set to 3.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: 指名exception寄存器写入导致cmderr=3的条件（含postexec位）

ref_atoms.ref_content:
Verify the read accessability of rom.

            - Read from the addresses of rom and verify that it reads the expected data.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: 指名ROM地址读取并验证期望数据

ref_atoms.ref_content:
Check the WARL behaviour of the hartsel field in dmcontrol

        - Write '1 to hartsel and then read dmcontrol back again.
        - Check resulting value of hartsel equals the maximum hart index.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: 指名hartsel字段的WARL行为，与最大hart索引比较

ref_atoms.ref_content:
A 'bug hunt' test that stresses the DUT to its limits.

            - Combine above sequences in one test and run as many of them as possible in parallel.
              Run the rest sequentially.
            - Randomly inject a full device reset intermittently.

Cover all possible types of accesses over SBA.

            - cp: reads and write accesses
            - cp: supported transfer sizes
            - cp: auto-increment address with back-to-back acesses
            - cp: for reads, cover readonaddr and readondata settings
            - cp: sberror cases with unaligned address and unsupported size
            - cp: sbbusyerror case - attempt new access before the previous one completed
            - cr: cross all of the above
在TL-UL设备接口可访问的内存映射中，地址范围0x100-0x10c（Halted, Going, Resuming, Exception）和0x380-0x382（DataAddr）为可读写区域，0x383 - 0x338未实现将读取未定义数据，其余所有区域均为只读。
ref_atoms.kind_reason: 明确指定TL-UL内存映射中的具体读写地址范围及未实现区域行为，提供可验证的访问权限信息。

ref_atoms.ref_content: Debug Module Registers仅能通过JTAG上的Debug Module Interface (DMI)访问，无法通过TL-UL设备接口访问。
ref_atoms.kind_reason: 明确Debug Module Registers仅限DMI/JTAG访问，禁止TL-UL访问，提供可验证的接口隔离行为。

ref_atoms.ref_content: RV_DM受生命周期控制，仅在TEST_UNLOCKED*、DEV和RMA状态下LC_HW_DEBUG_EN信号有效时才可用。在DEV状态下，支持通过固件实现后期使能，由OTP熔丝DIS_RV_DM_LATE_DEBUG和CSR LATE_DEBUG_ENABLE共同控制RV_DM的完全开启。真值表如下：当LC状态为TEST_UNLOCKED*或RMA时，无论OTP和CSR值如何，RV_DM可通过TAP访问且完全开启；PROD*、RAW或无效状态时不可访问；DEV状态下，若DIS_RV_DM_LATE_DEBUG为kMuBi8True，则可访问且完全开启；若DIS_RV_DM_LATE_DEBUG不为kMuBi8True且LATE_DEBUG_ENABLE不为kMuBi32True，则可访问但未完全开启；若LATE_DEBUG_ENABLE为kMuBi32True，则可访问且完全开启。
ref_atoms.kind_reason: 描述基于生命周期状态、OTP熔丝和CSR的RV_DM门控机制及具体真值表，提供明确的组合逻辑验证点。

ref_atoms.ref_content: 在非调试模块(NDM)复位请求期间，为防止生命周期门控机制切断RV_DM与JTAG调试器的连接，TAP/JTAG侧的门控逻辑由pinmux中strap采样模块提供的独立硬件调试使能信号调制，该信号在NDM复位过程中被锁存并保持稳定。
ref_atoms.kind_reason: 描述NDM复位期间使用pinmux稳定信号防止连接切断的硬件调制行为，提供具体时序和信号交互验证点。
